style: photorealistic portrait photograph, cinematic, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, low-key lighting with violet/blue/pink neon rim light, dark background with soft neon bokeh, vertical 2:3 half-body portrait from head to hips, camera at eye level, framing focused on the face, modest clothing fully covering the torso, no emphasis on legs, chest or body, age-appropriate, no text, no watermark
framing: Composition: tall vertical 2:3 image (1024x1536). The subject stands upright, centered, facing the camera in a slight three-quarter turn; the top of the head sits close below the upper edge with a little headroom, the face is in the upper third and is the sharpest point of the image, the frame ends at the hips (no thighs or legs visible). Camera exactly at eye level, never from below. Plain dark city-night background: out-of-focus neon bokeh only, no readable signs, no letters, no logos, no other people.
